title: GETAROUNDBOAT

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Looking for a unique way to explore the Homosassa River? Hop aboard one of our easy-to-use GoBoats and cruise over to the legendary Monkey Island! Located right in the middle of the river, Monkey Island is home to a group of spider monkeys living on their own private island - and it’s only accessible by water. With a GoBoat, you can float right up for a perfect view of the monkeys as they play, swing, and soak up the Florida sun. Our GoBoats are safe, stable, and fun for all ages. Whether you’re planning a relaxing solo ride or a fun outing with friends or family, this is a one-of-a-kind Homosassa experience you won’t want to miss. 🚣‍♂️No boating experience needed🦺 Life jackets provided📸

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Bring your friends, bring your dog (life jackets required) and enjoy 4 hours exploring the Homosassa River and Halls River on your GoBoat adventure. Cruising around @ 5 mph you can swim in the beautiful blue water of the Homosassa Springs where the water is crystal clear and Wildlife is abundant. You might even encounter manatees.

quotes.author: Lindsay Stewart
quotes.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ What an incredible experience! Renting a Go Boat was the perfect way to spend the day on the water. The boat was clean, easy to operate, and made for a relaxing and fun adventure. We cruised the river, took in the beautiful scenery, watched the monkeys on Monkey Island enjoying their breakfast, and explored the springs at our own pace. The entire rental process was seamless, and the staff (Paula) was friendly, helpful, and made sure we were comfortable before heading out. If you’re looking for a unique way to enjoy Florida’s natural beauty, I highly recommend renting a Go Boat. We made amazing memories and can’t wait to do it again! 5 stars all the way! 🚤☀️🌴

quotes.author: Jesse Masters
quotes.text: What an incredible experience. Everything was so beautiful. Monkey island is a must see! The springs were crystal clear. Best part was we saw a baby manatee in the springs, and a family of 6 manatee out in the channels. We spent a solid 10 minutes drifting as this family of manatees came right up to our boat multiple times. They swam right under us, and at one point, one guy surfaced about 1 foot from the edge of our boat. It was incrediblea My wife and two kids loved it too! Would highly recommend. Amazing!

quotes.author: Kelly Armstrong
quotes.text: This was so much fun and a unique experience! Four hours on the water with a motor making it an easy way to get around and see God’s beautiful creation! Went to the Springs, a restaurant and down the quiet, peaceful river side where we had a dolphin play with us! You can go to Mo key Island and see them too! Best $125 we spent in a long time! Thanks Paula!

quotes.author: Birgit Rehmann
quotes.text: Me and my friend had the best time on the Getaroundboat. It was a relaxing ride and we were the best advertisement. Many people asked where we rented the boat and loved it. Lots of people waved to us and thought we were the coolest ride around. Thank you Paula for the great guidance . It was awesome all the way around.😊

quotes.author: Shirley Gamache
quotes.text: We had such an amazing time renting the goboat! The weather was perfect, the scenery was absolutely beautiful, and we couldn’t have asked for a better day out on the water. Everything was such a great experience, and we will definitely be back again! Highly recommended, Paula! ☀️🚤🌊

quotes.author: Heidi Esparza
quotes.text: This was my second time renting. My friends and I had an amazing adventure aboard our GoBoats. We checked out Monkey Island and relaxed in the Springs. Paula provides you with instructions before your departure and is absolutely amazing. Highly recommended! 100000%
